source: 658 Deep Desire
target: 658 Profundus Desiderium

source: The merchant responded cautiously to Camus’s translation, “Sir, we don’t really have any special folklore festivals.
target: Mercator cum cautela respondit ad translationem Camus, “Domine, revera nullos habemus festos populares speciales.

source: We only celebrate two festivals every year.
target: Solum duas festivitates omni anno celebramus.

source: One is the Sun Sacrifice in December, and the other is the New Sun Festival in June.”
target: Una est Sacrificium Solis in Decembri, et altera est Novum Festum Solis in Iunio.

source: The Sun Sacrifice was a recurring festival for the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, marking the day with the longest daylight of the year when the sun reached its zenith at noon.
target: Sacrificium Solis erat festum recurrens Ecclesiae Aeternae Flammantis Solis, diem designans cum luce diurna longissima anni, cum sol ad apicem meridie attingebat.

source: In the Northern Continent, it took place in mid-to-late June, while in the Southern Continent, due to the reversed seasons, it occurred in mid-to-late December.
target: In Continente Septentrionali hoc eveniebat ex media ad finem Iunii, dum in Continente Meridionali, ob tempora conversa, eveniebat ex media ad finem Decembri.

source: The New Sun Festival, originating from the believers of the Southern Continent’s Eternal Blazing Sun, involved celebrations during the longest night and shortest days, welcoming the return of the sun and anticipating more light and warmer weather.
target: Novum Festum Solis, a fidelibus Continentis Meridionalis Ecclesiae Aeternae Flammantis Solis ortum, celebrationes complectebatur per noctem longissimam et dies brevissimos, reditum solis excipiens et lucem ampliorem necnon calorem venturum praenuntians.

source: This celebration often coincided with the New Year in many parts of the Southern Continent, gradually merging the two festivities.
target: Haec celebratio saepe coincidebat cum Novo Anno in multis partibus Continentis Meridionalis, duo festivitates paulatim coniungens.

source: The merchant explained that the citizens of Tizamo Town solely celebrated festivals connected to the Eternal Blazing Sun, having abandoned the traditions related to Death.
target: Mercator explanavit cives oppidi Tizamo solum celebrasse festivitates cum Aeternae Flammantis Solis coniunctas, consuetudines mortis relictos.

source: He reflected for a moment and added, “It’s been like this for a long time—since my grandfather was born.”
target: Paululum cogitavit et addidit, “Iamdiu ita fuit—ex quo avus meus natus est.”

source: Matani, particularly Port Pylos and the gold mine city of Devise, had been Intis’s colony for nearly a century.
target: Matani, praesertim Portus Pylos et urbs fodina auri Devise, fuisset colonia Intis per fere centum annos.

source: The native population was compelled to convert generations ago, becoming followers of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
target: Populatio indigena, abhinc generationes conversioni coacta, facta est sectatrix Aeternae Flammantis Solis.

source: This, however, was limited to areas effectively managed by colonial institutions in the past.
target: Hoc tamen ad regiones limitatum erat, quae ab institutionibus colonialibus in praeterito efficaciter administrabantur.

source: When Lumian arrived in Port Pylos, his first impression was: at the docks, in the heart of the city, it resembled the port cities of Intis.
target: Cum Lumian ad Portum Pylos pervenit, prima eius impressio fuit: ad ripa portus, in corde urbis, similis erat urbibus portuariis Intis.

source: Yet, the workers’ skin was darker and browner.
target: Attamen, cutis operariorum obscurior et fusca erat.

source: The streets frequented by Intisians and Feynapotterians were sparsely populated and desolate.
target: Viae, quas Intisii et Feynapotteriani frequentabant, exiguo populatae erant et desolatae.

source: After passing Hotel Orella and exploring other areas of Port Pylos, various buildings with West Balam characteristics emerged.
target: Postquam deversorium Orella transegerunt et alias partes Portus Pylos exploraverunt, varia aedificia cum notis Occidentis Balam emerserunt.

source: More pedestrians populated the streets, and the echoes of Dutanese filled the air.
target: Plures pedestres vias replebant, et resonantia Dutanica aerem complebant.

source: Lumian sought further details, indirectly confirming the merchant’s words.
target: Lumian plura quaerebat, verba mercatoris indirecte confirmans.

source: Interrogator Camus discerned no signs of deception.
target: Interrogator Camus nullas deceptionis notas animadvertit.

source: “What things have left a deep impression on you since you were young that you still remember from time to time?” Lumian shifted the conversation.
target: "Quae res te, ex iuventute, graviter impresserunt, quas adhuc interdum meministi?" Lumian sermonem mutavit.

source: Recalling, the merchant replied, “Grand funerals… Newly built coffins…
target: Recordans, mercator respondit, “Magnae funebres caerimoniae… Arcae funebres nuper constructae…

source: “The primitive tribe that clashes with us every year… The occasional scream at night because of them…
target: “Tribus primitiva quae nobis quotannis contegitur… Vociferationes nocturnae interdum propter eos…

source: “Everyone’s hardworking, calm, and well-educated. We get angry, but we don’t argue on the spot or shout. We choose to find the padre, officers, and judges to determine who’s right and who’s wrong…”
target: “Omnes industrii, tranquilli, et bene eruditi sunt. Irāmur, sed neque in loco contendimus neque clamamus. Eligimus patrem, magistratus, et iudices quaerere, ut rectum ab iniusto discernerimus…”

source: Camus translated the merchant’s words to Lumian, adding a few comments.
target: Camus verba mercatoris Luminum vertit, nonnulla addens.

source: “That’s indeed the case. I’ve been to Tizamo. The people there are very docile. Even if they’re treated unfairly, they rarely resist violently. The manor owners of the surrounding plantations love to hire them, reducing the cost of buying slaves.
target: "Id vere ita est. Ad Tizamo perrexi. Populus ibi valde mansuetus est. Etsi iniuste tractentur, raro vehementer resistunt. Domini praediorum circumstantium eos libere conducere amant, sumptus emptionis servorum minuendo.

source: “Of course, it’s not that they’re emotionless and won’t resist. Instead, they tend to abide by order and follow the official processes to resolve problems. I-I guess they can be considered outstanding believers of the Eternal Blazing Sun?”
target: "Certe, non est quod affectibus carentes sint nec resistent. Immo ordinem servare et officiales processus sequi, quaestionibus solvendis, malunt. Credeor eos esse praestantes fidem habentes Aeternae Flammantis Solis?"

source: The honorific name of the Eternal Blazing Sun contained the description “Embodiment of Order.”
target: Nomen honorificum Aeternae Flammantis Solis descriptionem “Incarnatio Ordinis” continebat.

source: As a member of the Feynapotter royal lineage, Camus undoubtedly believed in the Earth Mother.
target: Ut membrum regiae stirpis Feynapotter, Camus indubitanter in Matrem Terram credidit.

source: He knew that Louis Berry hailed from the Intis Republic and was likely a believer of the Eternal Blazing Sun.
target: Sciebat Ludovicum Berry ex Re Publica Intis provenire et verisimiliter fidem habere Aeternae Flammantis Solis.

source: Lumian stood up, extending his arms with a smile. “Praise the Sun!”
target: Lumian surrexit, brachia extendens cum risu. “Laudate Solem!”

source: “Praise the Sun!” The merchant hastily followed suit.
target: “Laudate Solem!” Mercator festinanter secutus est.

source: Lumian settled back into his seat, contemplating for a few fleeting moments.
target: Lumian iterum sedebat, per paucis momentis volubiliter meditans.

source: “Have you experienced any strange dreams?”
target: “Num aliquos somnia insolita habuisti?”

source: The merchant nodded, then shook his head.
target: Mercator annuit, deinde caput negavit.

source: “Many, but they slip away from memory. Do you not encounter such dreams?”
target: “Multa, sed ex memoria evanescunt. Num non incidis talia somnia?”

source: Indeed. Dreams often elude the control of one’s consciousness.
target: Immo, somnia saepe imperium conscientiae effugiunt.

source: They can reveal spiritual insights, mirror suppressed desires, or reflect events from the day.
target: Possunt spiritualia consilia revelare, desideria recondita speculare, aut eventa diei referre.

source: Sometimes, these elements intertwine, resulting in strange and unpredictable dreams.
target: Aliquando haec elementa inter se texuntur, producens somnia insolita et imprevisibilia.

source: I, too, frequently encounter such dreams.
target: Ego quoque saepe talia somnia experior.

source: In the past, when I battled the Demon corruption, they were even more bizarre and exaggerated…
target: Olim, cum corruptionem Daemonis pugnarem, ea adhuc mirabiliora atque hyperbolica erant…

source: Lumian sensed that the merchant’s response was impeccable.
target: Lumian sensit responsionem mercatoris esse impeccablem.

source: If the other party could pinpoint a specific strange dream, that might raise suspicion.
target: Si altera pars somnium insolitum certum delineare posset, id suspicionem excitare poterat.

source: Either the dream was exceptionally strange and unforgettable, or the merchant was abnormal and had prepared in advance before coming.
target: Aut somnium eximie insolutum atque inobliviabile erat, aut mercator abnormis fuit et prius praeparaverat.

source: After discussing other matters, Lumian escorted the merchant out of the master bedroom.
target: Postquam alias res disseruerunt, Lumian mercatorem e conclavi principali secum eduxit.

source: The responses of the other two Tizamons were similar to the merchant’s, only supplementing the details they observed at their level and sharing encounters with their own characteristics.
target: Responsa duorum aliorum Tizamorum mercatoris similia erant, additis singularibus quae ad gradum suum observaverant, et casus proprios notis communicantes.

source: Lumian found no traces of the Dream Festival.
target: Lumian nullas vestigia Festi Somniorum invenit.

source: If the Dream Festival is genuinely linked to Tizamo, there’s only one possibility: When the townsfolk fall asleep, they enter a dream world to celebrate the festival.
target: Si Festum Somniorum vere Tizamo coniungitur, una tantum possibilitas est: cum cives obdormiant, in mundum somniorum ingrediuntur ut festum celeberent.

source: Upon waking, they forget everything…
target: Expergiscente, omnia obliviscuntur…

source: Or, there’s another possibility.
target: Aut alia possibilitas est.

source: Two factions may be involved in Hisoka’s Tizamo Town prank.
target: Duae factiones in ioco Hisoka de oppido Tizamo implicari possunt.

source: First, the citizens of Tizamo.
target: Primum, cives Tizamo.

source: Second, the primitive tribe in the nearby forest.
target: Secundo, tribus primitiva in silva proxima.

source: Could the Dream Festival be a celebration for that primitive tribe?
target: Potestne Festum Somniorum celebrare illam tribum primitivam?

source: Hisoka’s prank impacted the Dream Festival, leading the primitive tribe to suddenly attack Tizamo, resulting in significant casualties and concealing the traces of his advancement ritual to Desire Apostle.
target: Iocus Hisoka Festum Somniorum affecit, tribum primitivam Tizamo subito impetum facere compellens, quo magnis caedibus evenit et vestigia rituum progressionis ad Apostolum Desiderii celata sunt.

source: Lumian pondered as he walked Camus and the three Tizamons to the door.
target: Lumian meditatus est dum Camus et tres Tizamones ad ianuam ducebat.

source: Upon returning to the master bedroom, he stood before the desk and gazed at the stone wall in front of him.
target: Rediens ad conclave principale, stetit ante mensam et parietem lapideum qui ante eum stabat, contemplatus est.

source: His eyes flickered with anticipation and unease.
target: Oculi eius exspectatione et inquietudine micabant.

source: His decision to stay in the Southern Continent and actively pursue Hisoka’s inheritance was indeed to grow amid blood, fire, chaos, and conflict, securing more acting opportunities.
target: Consilium eius in Continente Meridionali manendi et actu Hereditatem Hisokae persequendi re vera erat ad crescendum inter sanguinem, ignem, chaos et conflictum, atque ampliorem occasionem agendi assecurans.

source: He aimed to open the door to godhood and advance to Sequence 4 as soon as possible.
target: Illud intendebat: ostium deitatis aperire et ad Sequenciam IV quam primum progredi.

source: The reason for his impatience was: he saw a glimmer of hope in reviving his sister!
target: Causa impatiens eius erat: speciem spei reanimandae sororis suae intuebatur!

source: The state of the Naboredisleys on Hanth Island provided him with that glimmer of hope.
target: Status Naboredisleyorum in Insula Hanth ei illam speciem spei praebuit.

source: This hope stemmed from the belief that a high-ranking figure of the Earth Mother Church might possess the ability to divide another person’s soul.
target: Haec spes ex fide orta est quod figura eminentis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae animam alicuius alterius dividere valeat.

source: This would allow each soul fragment to grow into a relatively separate individual through rebirth.
target: Id permittet ut singula fragmenta animae per renascentiam in individua relative separata crescere queant.

source: Aurore’s soul fragment was sealed within Lumian’s body.
target: Fragmentum animae Aurore in corpore Lumiani sigillatum erat.

source: Perhaps a high-ranking member of the Church of Earth Mother could use one or more soul fragments to resurrect Aurore in a new form!
target: Forsitan membrum eminens Ecclesiae Matris Terrae unum vel plura fragmenta animae ad Aurore in nova forma resurrectum uti posset!

source: Lumian wasn’t certain if such a plan could be realized or if it constituted true “resurrection,” but it was the most plausible method he had encountered so far.
target: Lumian non certo sciebat an talis consilium perficere posset aut veram “resurrectionem” constitueret, sed methodus maxime plausibilis erat quam usque ad hunc diem advenerat.

source: He was determined to give it a try.
target: Determinatus est id conari.

source: Of course, he couldn’t experiment with Aurore’s soul fragment directly.
target: Certe, fragmento animae Aurore directe experimentari non potuit.

source: His plan was to deliberately create some soul fragments in future cullings and seek help from the Church of Earth Mother to see if they could be reborn and if the person who returned was the same individual.
target: Consilium eius erat, in futuris depurationibus, aliqua fragmenta animae deliberate creare et auxilium petere a Ecclesia Matris Terrae, ut videatur an renasci possent et an persona quae redeat eadem esset.

source: Once all the details were confirmed, he would revive Aurore.
target: Quotiens omnia singula confirmata essent, Aurore revivificabit.

source: Lumian didn’t believe he had the qualifications to collaborate with the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Lumian non credebat se idoneum esse ad cooperandum cum Ecclesia Matris Terrae.

source: Only by becoming a demigod and relying on the secret organization, the Tarot Club, could he gain the Church of Earth Mother’s attention and fulfill the transaction conditions proposed by the other party.
target: Solum, factus semideus et innixus organizationi secretae, “Tarot Club”, poterat Ecclesiam Matris Terrae attentionem captare et condicionibus transactionis ab altera parte propositis obtemperare.

source: For this, Lumian couldn’t wait to obtain godhood and advance to Sequence 4.
target: Propter hoc, Lumian exspectare non poterat ut deitatem adipisceretur et ad Sequenciam IV procederet.

source: At times, Lumian wished his sister were also a Blessed of Celestial Worthy and had inherited the ancient castle.
target: Interdum Lumian optabat ut soror eius etiam esset Beata Caelestis Digna et antiquum castrum hereditasset.

source: This way, her resurrection might be more straightforward.
target: Hoc modo eius resurrectio fortasse simplicior esset.

source: Yes, to extract Aurore’s soul fragment, I must undo Mr. Fool’s seal.
target: Ita, ad extrahendum fragmentum animae Aurore, sigillum Domini Stulti dissolvere debeo.

source: To undo his seal, I have to wait for Termiboros to become very weak.
target: Ut sigillum eius dissolvas, exspectandum est, ut Termiboros valde infirmus fiat.

source: For Termiboros to weaken, I need to continuously extract his power at a higher level.
target: Ut Termiboros debilitaret, necesse est me potentiam eius ex alio gradu continuo extrahere.

source: And to withstand the power of a higher level, I have to possess godhood and advance step by step…
target: Et ut potentiam gradus superioris sustineam, deitatem habere ac gradatim progredi debeo…

source: Lumian’s thoughts gradually clarified, and he unprecedentedly yearned for an advancement.
target: Cogitationes Lumiani paulatim clarificatae sunt, et inusitate progressionem desideravit.

source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
target: Trier, Districtus Cathédralis Commemorativae, Conclave 702, 9 Via Orosai.

source: Franca lay on the bed beneath a velvet blanket, her cheeks still flushed, eyes moist, and her expression unusually complicated.
target: Franca iacebat in lecto sub stragula velutinum, maxillae eius adhuc rubentes, oculi humidique, et vultus eius insolite perplexus.

source: Beside her, Jenna rested under the same velvet cover.
target: Secum, Jenna sub eodem stragulo velutinorum quievit.

source: She had slipped into a deep slumber, her brows furrowed with a mix of exhaustion, satisfaction, resistance, and nostalgia.
target: Illa in profundum somnum lapsa erat, supercilia eius mixturae lassitudinis, satisfactionis, resistantiae, et nostalgiae contrita erant.

source: Her outstretched arms and exposed fair skin still bore traces of the recent fervor.
target: Brachia eius extenditata et cutis nuda candida adhuc vestigia recentis ardoris portabant.

source: Franca gazed at Jenna and let out a sudden sigh.
target: Franca Jennam aspexit et subitam suspirationem edidit.

source: The experience had exceeded her expectations, yet a sense of emptiness lingered in her heart.
target: Experientia ea exspectationes suae superaverat, sed sensus inanitatis in corde eius permanebat.

source: It was beautiful in the moment, but what would transpire after the digestion of the Pleasure potion?
target: In momento pulchrum erat, sed quid eveniret post digestionem poculi Voluptatis?

source: Could physical intimacy and emotional distance coexist?
target: Possuntne intimitas corporalis et distantia animi coexistere?

source: Did overwhelming pleasure pave the way for sorrow? Was it the agony of sinking into oblivion while resisting salvation?
target: Num voluptas opprimenti viam luctus fecit? Fuitne id dolor deprimendi in oblivionem, dum salutem repugnabat?

source: Sigh… Franca released another soft sigh.
target: Suspiravit… Franca aliam levem suspirationem edidit.

source: She sensed that her Pleasure potion had been substantially digested.
target: Sensiuit poculum Voluptatis eius admodum digestum fuisse.

source: Matani State, Port Pylos.
target: Status Matani, Portus Pylos.

source: Lumian, sipping a glass of Gwadar, looked up and spoke to Lugano as if discussing the weather.
target: Lumian, poculum Gwadar sorbillans, sursum aspexit et ad Lugano locutus est quasi de caelo dissereret.

source: “We’re heading to Tizamo Town today. Will you join Ludwig and me, or will you stay here and wait for us?
target: “Hodie ad oppidum Tizamo pergimus. Mecum et Ludovico ades, an hic maneas et nos exspectabis?

source: “Let me warn you in advance. The situation in Tizamo Town might be very dangerous.”
target: "Praemonere te ante omnia sinas. Status in oppido Tizamo fortasse valde periculosus erit."

source: Very dangerous… He wanted to say he’d stay in Port Pylos, but memories of Father Montserrat flashed in his mind.
target: Valde periculosum… Vellet dicere se in Portu Pylos manere, sed memoriae Patris Montserrat in mente eius fulserunt.

source: Gritting his teeth, he replied, “I’m with you.”
target: Dentes strinxit et respondit: “Sum tecum.”

source: If danger lurked in Tizamo Town, he could rely on his boss to bail him out. But here? Only himself!
target: Si periculum in oppido Tizamo latebat, magistrum suum sperare poterat ut eum eriperet. Sed hic? Solum se ipsum!

source: Lumian nodded slightly and didn’t say more.
target: Lumian leviter annuit nec plura enuntiavit.

source: After checking out and hitting the street, he chuckled at Lugano and Ludwig, “Do we take a coffin to Tizamo, or should we grab a carriage?”
target: Postquam rem exasperavit et in viam profectus est, ad Lugano et Ludovicum risum edidit, “Utrum arcam funebrem ad Tizamo feramus, an cisium sumamus?”

source: Before Lugano and Ludwig could answer, a four-wheeled, four-seater carriage rolled up from under the shade.
target: Antequam Lugano et Ludovicus responderent, cisium quattuor rotarum, quattuor sedens, sub umbra profectum est.

source: The carriage’s driver, a young man, kept his head low, not daring to look away.
target: Auriga cisii, iuvenis, caput humile tenebat, non audens oculos avertire.

source: Coming to a stop, Camus Castiya emerged. He forced a smile and said to Lumian, “Thanks for your help these past days. I’ll escort you to Tizamo.”
target: Stantibus confirmatis, Camus Castiya exortus est. Risum coegit et Lumiano dedit verba: “Gratias pro auxilio his proximis diebus. Te ad Tizamo comitabiturus sum.”
